error_clusters.lesson: A scalar field must abstain when current rows disagree; a common value is allowed only when every relevant current row agrees.
Never synthesize totals, averages, ratios or dates across rows or measurement bases unless the document directly discloses the normalized value.
Use the current action date, not a performance-period start, announcement footer or one date selected from an aggregate multi-event disclosure.
Distinguish transaction counterparties from generic institution classes and selling holders; reconstruct explicit aliases and separately named agreement parties without inventing entities.
Section headings and bare action verbs are not sufficient; supported outputs must include the identifiable object, exposure, control or concrete risk content.

required_controls: substantive risk and event-stage completeness checks
forward_actions.evaluation_rule: Freeze a new prompt and validator, create a fresh unread human gold lock before requests, and never reuse the consumed v18 batch for scoring.
forward_actions.holdout_rule: Keep the extraction holdout locked until a fresh model-selection batch passes every predefined gate.
